mapper.insert: insert into QUEST ( USER_ID, SIMULATION_ID, SIMULATION_ITEM_ID, TRANSACTION_ID, QUEST_TYPE, QUEST_TITLE, QUEST_DESCRIPTION, QUEST_DEADLINE, QUEST_STATUS, QUEST_URL, EXP_REWARD, QUEST_COMPLETED_AT ) values ( #{userId}, #{simulationId}, #{simulationItemId}, #{transactionId}, #{questType}, #{questTitle}, #{questDescription}, #{questDeadline}, #{questStatus}, #{questUrl}, #{expReward}, #{questCompletedAt} )
mapper.select: select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.USER_ID = #{userId} order by Q.QUEST_ID asc

select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, P.POLICY_NAME as policyName, P.POLICY_URL as policyUrl, P.DUE_DATE as policyDueDate from QUEST Q left join SIMULATION_ITEM I on Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID = I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID left join POLICY P on I.POLICY_ID = P.POLICY_ID where Q.USER_ID = #{userId} order by case I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY when 'EXPENSE' then 1 when 'INCOME' then 2 when 'POLICY' then 3 else 4 end, Q.QUEST_ID asc

select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} order by Q.QUEST_ID asc

select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.QUEST_ID = #{questId}
mapper.update: update QUEST set QUEST_STATUS = #{questStatus}, QUEST_COMPLETED_AT = case when #{questStatus} = 'COMPLETED' then now() else null end where QUEST_ID = #{questId}
